messages:
maya: Hi @people-ops — planning parental leave starting 2026-11-15. Quick: what's the absolute latest to upload hospital/adoption docs so benefits and payroll aren't affected?

mira (People Ops): Congrats, Maya! :tada: Best practice: upload within 14 days of filing the leave request. For payroll continuity aim for 10 business days before your first payroll cutoff. If you miss it we can retro-process but it delays employer contributions.

maya: Got it. Any preferred filename convention? Also can I request a phased return (50% for 4 weeks)?

mira (People Ops): Filename suggestion: maya_parleave_20261115.pdf — helps our ops queue. Yes, add "phased return: 50% for 4w" in the notes when you submit; manager approval required. We'll add a RTW checklist and calendar reminder.

kevin: Team coverage note: I can take primary on-call for the first 3 weeks, then we rotate. Maya, can you add a short prioritized task list + any access transfer notes in the coverage box?

maya: Will do. Also putting a 1-hr overlap session on 2026-11-08.

mira (People Ops): One more: if you're adding a partner to benefits, file the Dependents form in Benefits -> Dependents within 30 days after the event. Daycare subsidy enrollments must be uploaded within 10 business days to start subsidy at leave start.

people-ops-bot: reminder: "Submit leave request in HR portal and upload supporting docs. Recommended processing deadline: 2026-11-01 to ensure payroll continuity."

maya: Thanks all — submitting now and will DM @mira if any tight timelines. :heart:
